name: 23225 · Richmond, VA
findings: ZIP 23225 (Richmond) has 155 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23225 (Richmond) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
